name: NTT Global Data Centers Campus Nierstein (Rhein-Selz-Park)
developer: NTT Global Data Centers / NTT Data
notes: NTT GDC campus on the former US Army barracks site in Nierstein (Rhein-Selz-Park, Landkreis Mainz-Bingen). Bebauungsplan adopted by Nierstein council (Satzungsbeschluss) and FNP amendment in force - land-use approved; Datacenter-Insider reports 482 MW campus; ZEIT reports ~480 MW IT load, making it one of the largest DC sites in Europe; construction start reported for 2026 (byc-news). Status: approved (land-use-planning complete), construction expected to begin 2026. ~400 jobs.

name: LDI - Landesbetrieb Daten und Information (Landesrechenzentrum RLP) Mainz
notes: LDI (Landesbetrieb Daten und Information), Valenciaplatz 6, 55118 Mainz, is the central IT/digitalisation service provider of Rhineland-Palatinate and operates the state data centre (historically Landesrechenzentrum Rheinland-Pfalz in Mainz, confirmed by Computerwoche). Official state operator page = A. Government data centre; capacity MW not published.

name: RHRK - Regionales Hochschulrechenzentrum Kaiserslautern (RPTU)
notes: RHRK is the regional university computing centre at RPTU Kaiserslautern (city), serving TU Kaiserslautern and the region incl. DFKI; institutional HPC/computing centre, comparable to state HPC facilities. Official university page = A for existence. Research/education facility; capacity MW not published.

name: BASF Rechenzentrum Ludwigshafen (enterprise data centre)
notes: BASF operates enterprise data-centre/IT infrastructure at its Ludwigshafen main site (historically documented mainframe computing centre since the 1970s per Computerwoche). No current public facility page or MW capacity found in this run - recorded as C-grade weak/aggregate evidence; enterprise (non-commercial) facility.
